steps.name: I am signed in to EventHub

elements.name: Admin Events page renders management controls

steps.name: I open the Admin Events page
the Admin Events page should show the create form and events table
I request the API health endpoint
the API health response should be successful

elements.name: Registered user can authenticate through API

steps.name: I authenticate through the API
the API should return the registered user identity
the API response should match schema "schemas/login-response.schema.json"

elements.name: Authenticated user can list events through API

steps.name: I request events through the API
the API events response should include seeded EventHub events
the API response should match schema "schemas/events-response.schema.json"

elements.name: Authenticated user can create and cancel a booking through API

steps.name: I create a booking through the API
the API booking response should include a booking reference
the API response should match schema "schemas/booking-response.schema.json"
I cancel the API-created booking
the API booking cancellation should be successful

elements.name: Registered user can sign in and sign out

steps.name: I am on the EventHub login page
I sign in with valid registered credentials
I should see the authenticated navigation
I sign out
I should be returned to the login page
